fields.prculley\n\n 2021-03-25 15:55\n\nmanager:
Ugly.
The sequence to replicate:
In ToDo Gramplet, Edit a note.
In Note Editor, make a new link
In Link Editor, select Note, and use New button
In Note Editor (2nd one!) make up a note, and hit save.

It appears that back in 2007 https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps/commit/6aad932574bcc7c2be2c419cb2d9068f0fb0815d
the Note editor was changed to pass the handle of a Note to the callback, rather than the Note object. Unfortunately, the EditLink call back function expects the object, not the handle. All other primary objects pass the object in their callbacks, so EditNote is the only one that is messed up.

I cannot tell why the 2007 commit changed this, but the NoteTab code does currently expect the EditNote callback to be a handle as well.

I think to fix this will best be done by reverting part of the 2007 commit, to go back to passing object. I looked around a bit, but was not able to quickly find any other code utilizing EditNote that depended on the callback... Don't have time to deal with this now, especially as it will take some analysis to make SURE that something else doesn't get messed up.
